title: Bending dot lattice — subtle edge
headline:
Build systems
your team can trust.
description: The same pale-blue type and dot lattice, with only a subtle cyan tint at the far right edge.
sampleTitle: Build systems your team can trust
prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit only the supplied finished Recoup blog thumbnail, preserving the original 16:9 framing and resolution. The provided image is the EDIT TARGET, not an inspiration reference.
Make exactly one very restrained change: add a barely noticeable localized gradient at the far RIGHT edge behind the existing dot pattern. The existing pale ice-blue background should drift to a slightly deeper soft cyan at the outermost edge only. Feather it invisibly back into the original color within roughly the last 10–15% of width; most of the visible color shift belongs to the last 5%. Keep the rest of the image unchanged. This should feel like 95% of the original plus 5% atmosphere, not a gradient redesign.
Preserve verbatim the same headline and exact two-line break:
Build systems
your team can trust.
Keep every letter's position, size, weight, tracking, color and spacing identical. Keep every dot, its size, location, color, spacing and the entire dot lattice geometry identical. Keep the solid pale blue behind the headline and the central 80–90% of the image unchanged. Do not place any color wash behind the headline.
No other changes. No new grain, texture, noise, objects, light beams, highlights, shading, logos, frames, text or decoration. No full-width or diagonal gradient. Do not intensify the existing colors. Output ONE finished image.

title: Parallel curves — subtle edge
headline:

into a system.
description: The same lime type and parallel curves, with a small cooler tint at the lower-right tip.
sampleTitle: Turn repeated work into a system
prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the supplied finished Recoup blog thumbnail very minimally. The image is the exact EDIT TARGET. Preserve the original 16:9 dimensions and composition.

into a system.

No other changes: no new grain, noise, texture, objects, photography, shadows, neon bloom, logos, additional wording or framing. No overall color grading. Output ONE finished image.
